shellCommands.command: ls -a && cat package.json && cat AGENTS.md && ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui -R | head -50
find src -type f | head -30 && cat src/*.tsx | head -80; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -150

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components versions --json | tail -15; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components peerDependencies; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@latest version
for v in 4.1.0 4.0.0 3.4.2 3.3.2; do echo "== $v"; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@$v peerDependencies --json; done

npm install @gravity-ui/date-components@4.1.0 @gravity-ui/date-utils@^2.6.0 2>&1 | tail -8; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/docs 2>/dev/null; grep -n -i -B2 -A25 "required setup\|calendar" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/README.md | head -120; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/components/Calendar; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/components/Calendar/Calendar.d.ts
npx tsc --noEmit && echo TSC_OK; npm run build 2>&1 | grep -i -E "error|built in"; git status --short; rm -rf dist; git status --short | grep dist
